notes: This page is an introduction (title and text about Brick Sketches) with no building step, so no pieces or joins are added. The parts list (151 pieces) is noted for later pages.

This page is a generic four-panel illustration: open the box, sort the pieces, build. It has no building step, so no pieces are added.
Step 1 places the white 4x12 plate (b1) as the base.
Step 2 puts the grey 1x6 plate (b2) on the base. Two red 2x3 tiles (b3, b4) sit side by side on it.
Each red tile overhangs the grey plate by one row toward the back. I assumed the tiles clutch only the grey plate, not the base plate.

Step 3 adds two red 3x2 left wedge plates (one at each end) and two red 1x2 plates. The picture shows the 1x2 plates without studs, but the parts list has only a red 1x2 plate (lego-3023), so I used that.
The exact overlap of the wedges and red plates with the red tiles is hard to read from the picture. I assumed they clutch the base plate and the nearest red tile.
Step 4 puts the black 1x3 tile (b9) on the front of the base plate. I assumed it rests on the base plate only.

Correction to the previous page: the black tile b9 is a Tile 2 x 4 with Groove (lego-87079, Black), not a 1x3 tile. The parts list has only one black 1x3 tile, and the picture shows a 2-wide tile. It sits over the seam between the two base plates, so it clutches both b1 and b10.
Step 5 adds a second white 4x12 plate (b10) on the front side of the first (b1). Plates placed side by side do not clutch each other, so the black tile holds them together.
Step 6 adds a second black Tile 2 x 4 with Groove (b11) in line with b9. It overhangs the front edge of b10 and rests only on b10.
Step 7 adds a third white 4x12 plate (b12) beside the existing plates. It clutches nothing below, so rests_on is empty.
I assumed it is held to the other plates only by pieces added in later steps.
Step 8 adds two dark turquoise 2x8 plates, one on each side of the black tiles. They bridge the seams between the white base plates and so lock them together.
It also adds two red flat pieces. I read them as red Tile 2 x 4 with Groove (lego-87079), the only red 2x4 tile in the parts list.
Which base plates each piece clutches is estimated from the isometric view and may be off by one plate.
Step 9 adds two red 2x2 corner plates, two red 1x2 plates and two red 1x3 tiles. They are mirrored left and right. The tiles line the inner edges next to the turquoise plates.
The exact support of each piece is hard to read from the isometric view. The rests_on lists are best guesses and may be off.
Step 10 adds a black Tile 2 x 4 with Groove (b23) in line with the two black tiles already placed (b9, b11). It overhangs the front edge. I assumed it clutches only the front base plate b10.
Step 11 adds the fourth white 4x12 plate (b24) in front, completing the 12x16 canvas. It clutches nothing below.
The black tile b23 overhangs the seam, so I assumed it clutches b24 too and recorded that as a join.
Step 12 covers the front plate b24 with red pieces: one 1x10 plate, two 4x4 plates, two 1x2 plates and two 1x3 tiles.

The exact positions are hard to read from the isometric view. I assumed each piece rests on the front plate b24, and the tiles also on b10 where they cross the seam. These rests_on lists are best guesses.
Step 13 adds two white 1x6 plates along the front edge, one white 3x2 right wedge plate (right corner) and one white 3x2 left wedge plate (left corner).
The side view shows white stacked on the red layer, so I assumed these clutch the red 1x10 and red 4x4 plates from step 12. The exact support is a best guess.
Step 14 adds two white 1x3 jumper plates with 2 studs and one light bluish gray 1x6 plate. Together they make a 12-wide row (3+6+3) behind the white front row.
I assumed this row sits on the red front-layer plates from step 12. The supporting pieces are a best guess.

Step 15 adds a tan 2x4 plate in the centre, a white 2x2 left wedge plate and a white 2x2 right wedge plate beside it, and two light bluish gray round 1x1 tiles on the red plates at the left and right.
I read the grey discs as Tile Round 1 x 1 (lego-98138), since the parts list has five of them. Which pieces each one clutches is a best guess.

Step 16 adds a dark turquoise 2x8 plate (b44) that lies across the two earlier turquoise plates. It clutches their studs and bridges over the black tiles. It also adds two white 1x6 tiles with groove (b45, b46) forming a 12-wide strip across the front assembly.
Which pieces the white tiles clutch is a best guess from the isometric view.
Step 17 adds a white 3x2 left wedge plate, a white 3x2 right wedge plate, a white 1x6 tile with groove and two light bluish gray round 1x1 tiles.
The wedges and the tile sit on the turquoise bridge plate b44. The round tiles go on the studs of the turquoise plates b13 and b14. The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 18 adds one white 2x10 plate (b52) across the turquoise plates above the black tiles. I assumed it clutches the turquoise plates b13 and b14 and bridges over the black tiles.
Step 19 adds two white 4x4 round-corner plates, which form the rounded top of the helmet, and one white 2x4 tile with groove between them.
The pieces sit on the white 2x10 plate b52 and the turquoise plates. The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 20 adds a white 2x6 plate and two white 4x4 curved (macaroni) tiles that form the rim of the helmet top.
The plate shows about 7 studs per row, but I used the only matching white plate in the parts list (2x6, lego-3795). The supports are best guesses.
Step 21 adds two white 1x3 plates, two red 1x3 tiles (the visor detail), one white 2x2 left wedge plate and one white 2x2 right wedge plate.
The plates in the picture look slightly angled, but I treated them as plain 1x3 plates (lego-3623). The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 22 adds two black 3x3 cut-corner wedge plates and one black 2x4 tile with groove. Together they form the visor, with the tile in the middle and a wedge on each side.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 23 adds two light bluish gray 3x3 plates and two different black wedge plates.
I read the first wedge as Wedge Plate 2x4 (lego-51739) and the second as a 27° 2x4 wedge. I chose the left version (lego-65429); it could be the right version (lego-65426).
The supports are best guesses from the picture.

Step 24 adds two white hinge plates. I identified them as the Hinge Plate 1x4 Swivel Top / Base (lego-73983), the only white 1x4 hinge-type piece in the parts list. They sit at the lower left and lower right near the tan plate.
Which pieces they clutch is a best guess. Any clip or hinge joins to later pieces will appear when those pieces are placed.
Step 25 adds a black 1x6 tile with groove along the lower edge of the visor and two black quarter-round 1x1 tiles at its ends.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 26 adds a white tile and a white 2x2 left and a white 2x2 right wedge plate at the front (chin) area.
I read the tile as Tile 2 x 4 with Groove (lego-87079). The supports are best guesses from the picture.

Step 27 turns the model over to show the underside. A white 1x10 plate (b80) is clutched onto the anti-studs under the base plates along one long edge. It locks the separate 4x12 base plates together.
Which base plates it spans is estimated: I assumed it crosses b10, b12 and b24.
Step 28 puts a light bluish gray 1x4 plate and two white 1x3 plates on the studs of the underside 1x10 plate b80. They fill its 10 studs (4+3+3).
I assumed all three clutch only b80.
Step 29 adds a white 3x2 plate with rounded end and hole, and two white 1x2 hinge plates with one finger. The hinge plates go on the grey 1x4 plate and on the end 1x3 plate of the underside.
The supports are best guesses from the picture. Hinge fingers will connect to other hinge parts in later steps.
Step 30 adds a white 1x10 plate on the underside edge. The picture shows white, so I used white even though the remaining-parts list still shows only a red 1x10.
I assumed it sits on top of the grey 1x4 and the two white 1x3 plates (4+3+3 = 10 studs) from step 28. The hinge plates from step 29 may share those studs; the exact stacking is unclear.

Step 31 is a separate sub-assembly: two white elbow tubes (b88, b89) are joined by a red 2-long axle (b90) to make a U shape. A grey 11-long axle (b91, b92) is added to each open end. It is not yet attached to the main model.
The box also lists 2 white hinge cylinders (lego-57360). They are not used in the steps shown on this page, so I assume they are used on the next page.
Which end of each elbow takes the red axle and which takes the long axle is assumed from the drawing.
Step 4 (shown at 1:1 scale with the axle length marked 11) puts a white hinge cylinder on the end of each long axle of the U-assembly from step 31.
The U-assembly is then clicked onto the two hinge plates (b85, b86) on the underside of the model. This makes a swing-out stand.
Which hinge-cylinder finger port mates with which hinge plate is assumed.
Step 32 builds a white brick frame on the underside of the model. Two 1x16 bricks run along the long edges and a 1x10 brick closes one end.
The picture also shows the back wall of the frame, which I took to be the pieces already placed in steps 27-30.
Which base plates each brick clutches is estimated. The 1x16 bricks span all four plates, and the 1x10 is assumed to sit on the end plate b1.

Step 33 puts four light bluish gray round 1x1 bricks with open studs on the four corners of the brick frame. They sit on the end studs of the two long 1x16 bricks (b95, b96). Presumably they act as feet or supports for the stand.
Step 34 puts a white round 2x2 plate with rounded bottom on each of the four round bricks from step 33. They act as feet. Each one sits on a single round brick.
Step 35 turns the model back over and adds two more white 4x4 round-corner plates at the top of the helmet.
I assumed they overlap the first pair of round-corner plates and the 2x6 plate. The exact support is a best guess.
Step 36 adds a tan 2x4 plate above the visor and two white 1x3 plates in the helmet top.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 37 adds two white 1x3 plates and two black wedge plates. The wedges flank the tan plate at the top of the visor.
The two black wedges look the same in the picture, but the only black wedge plates still unplaced in the parts list are one lego-51739 and one lego-65426, so I used those.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 38 adds a second tan 2x4 plate on the visor, plus a white 2x2 left wedge and a white 2x2 right wedge beside it.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 39 adds one black curved 2x2x2/3 brick and four black 1x2 jumper plates on the visor area.
The jumper plates (offset single stud) sit mostly on the visor wedges and plates. All supports are best guesses from the picture.

Step 40 builds a small white sub-assembly, then sets it on the front left of the model. Sub-step 1 stacks two white 3x2 rounded plates (b124 lower, b123 upper, offset). Sub-step 2 adds a white curved 2x1 brick (b125). Sub-step 3 adds the grate slope (b127) and the corner tile (b126). The corner tile is not clearly shown, so its position is a guess.
The lower plate b124 is assumed to sit on the jumper plate b36 at the left front of the model. This is a guess.
Step 41 builds the same small sub-assembly as step 40 (two rounded plates, curved brick, corner tile, grate slope) and sets it on the right front of the model. This is the mirror of the left one.
The lower plate b129 is assumed to sit on the jumper plate b37. The corner tile position is a guess.
Step 42 adds a white 1x6 tile with groove across the top of the visor (the brow), with a white curved 2x1 brick at each end.
I assumed the tile covers the two white 1x3 plates from step 37 and each curved brick sits on a black wedge. These are best guesses.
Step 43 adds a white 2x2 left wedge and a white 2x2 right wedge, a tan 2x4 plate and two black 2x4 tiles with groove. They fill the visor area.
The parts-list tracker shows no black 2x4 tiles left, but the original list has six and only four are placed so far, so two remain.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 44 adds the second white 2x6 plate and a long, thin black tile at the lower front of the visor.

I read the black tile as the black Tile 1 x 3 (lego-63864). That is the only black tile still unaccounted for, since the one black 1x6 tile went into step 25. This also relies on my earlier correction that b9 is a 2x4 tile.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 45 adds two white 4x2 right wedge plates and two white 4x2 left wedge plates, which build up the lower face.
The picture shows 3 studs on each wedge, which fits the 4x2 wedges (the only 4x2 white wedges in the parts list).
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 46 adds two white 4x2 right wedge plates and two white 4x2 left wedge plates, and a light bluish gray round 1x1 tile on the tip stud of one wedge. The tile sits at the centre of the chin.

Correction to step 45: the wedges there had 3 studs along their length, so they were probably white 3x2 wedges (two lego-43722 and two white lego-43723), not 4x2 ones. The 4-stud wedges on this page are the 4x2 ones. Step 45 pieces b143-b146 are therefore likely mistyped. I could not change earlier output.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
This page has no building step. It shows the finished model from the back with the U-shaped stand (b88-b94) swung out on its hinges (b93, b94 to b85, b86) so the model stands upright.

The parts list still shows a few unplaced pieces (white 3x2 right wedges, red 3x2 left wedges, red 1x3 tile, red 2x4 tile). I think this comes from earlier steps where I had to guess piece types and colours, not from pieces missing in the model. They may still appear on a later page.
This page has no building step. It shows the finished First Order Stormtrooper Brick Sketch standing on its swing-out stand. No pieces are added.
This page is an advertisement for the LEGO product feedback prize draw. It has no building step, so no pieces are added.

Four parts-list lines are still unplaced: white 3x2 right wedges (43722) x2, red 3x2 left wedges (43723) x2, red 1x3 tile x1 and red 2x4 tile x1. The previous page was the finished model and no page shows them being placed. The earlier red pieces (b3-b8, b15-b22, b25-b31) were assigned from the pictures. I could not match every red piece type to the parts list. The unplaced red items are probably some of those with the wrong type, and the unplaced white wedges are probably the ones I recorded as 4x2 wedges in step 45 (b143-b146).
This is the complete corrected list of all 151 pieces. Ids are unchanged and every piece is restated, because several earlier entries had to change.

Disconnected groups: the stand (b88-b94) looked separate because my earlier joins named ports (e.g. 'b93:hinge.1') in the endpoints. Joins now name plain piece ids and put the port in the method text. The stand is joined to the model by hinge cylinders b93 and b94 clicking into hinge plates b85 and b86. That is the only link, and it is hinged on purpose so the stand can swing out.
Parts-list fixes, step 3: the two flat red pieces b7, b8 are red Tile 1x3 (lego-63864), not Plate 1x2. This also fixes the surplus red 1x2 plates.

Parts-list fixes, step 4: the black tile b9 is a Tile 2x4 with Groove (lego-87079). Step 45 wedges b143-b146 have 3 studs, so they are white 3x2 wedges (b143, b144 lego-43722 right; b145, b146 lego-43723 left), not 4x2. The real 4x2 wedges (lego-41769 and lego-41770, two each) are b147-b150 in step 46. All piece types now match the parts list counts.

Tile supports: tiles have no studs, so no piece rests on a tile now. The earlier tile supports (b3, b4, b15, b16, b42, b43, b55) are removed from rests_on. The pieces above them (b5-b8, b17-b20, b45, b46, b56, b61, b62) now rest on the studded pieces beside them, such as the base plates, turquoise plates, tan plate and 2x10 plate.
Support lists are still estimated from isometric drawings. Some tiles overhang the studded pieces they sit beside.
Join in step 8 (black tile b9 across the base-plate seam) and the one in step 11 (b23) are kept as other_joins. They bridge the separate 4x12 base plates, which otherwise only touch side by side.
The separate-groups problem is fixed: the stand (b88-b94) is joined to the model through the hinge cylinders b93 and b94 and the hinge plates b85 and b86.

The remaining flags come from earlier entries that this check will not let me edit. Types and supports given earlier are kept, and my corrected restatement was not applied. It also added to the supports instead of replacing them, which is why b19 and b20 now show three supports. Adding more pieces would only duplicate physical pieces, so I add nothing.

Intended corrections, if earlier entries can be edited: b7 and b8 are red Tile 1x3 (lego-63864), not lego-3023. b9 is a black Tile 2x4 with Groove (lego-87079). b143 and b144 are white lego-43722. b145 and b146 are white lego-43723. With these, all type counts match the parts list (151 pieces).

Intended support corrections: no piece rests on a tile. b5-b8 rest on b1 only. b17 and b19 rest on b10 and b13. b18 and b20 rest on b12 and b14. b45 rests on b40 and b39. b46 rests on b41 and b39. b56 rests on b52 only. b61 and b62 rest on b56 only. Where tiles overhang, the draw-ups are estimates from the isometric views.

Step 33 puts four light bluish gray round 1x1 bricks with open studs on the four corners of the brick frame. They sit on the end studs of the two long 1x16 bricks (b95, b96). Presumably they act as feet or supports for the stand.
Step 34 puts a white round 2x2 plate with rounded bottom on each of the four round bricks from step 33. They act as feet. Each one sits on a single round brick.
Step 35 turns the model back over and adds two more white 4x4 round-corner plates at the top of the helmet.
I assumed they overlap the first pair of round-corner plates and the 2x6 plate. The exact support is a best guess.
Step 36 adds a tan 2x4 plate above the visor and two white 1x3 plates in the helmet top.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 37 adds two white 1x3 plates and two black wedge plates. The wedges flank the tan plate at the top of the visor.
The two black wedges look the same in the picture, but the only black wedge plates still unplaced in the parts list are one lego-51739 and one lego-65426, so I used those.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 38 adds a second tan 2x4 plate on the visor, plus a white 2x2 left wedge and a white 2x2 right wedge beside it.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 39 adds one black curved 2x2x2/3 brick and four black 1x2 jumper plates on the visor area.
The jumper plates (offset single stud) sit mostly on the visor wedges and plates. All supports are best guesses from the picture.

Step 40 builds a small white sub-assembly, then sets it on the front left of the model. Sub-step 1 stacks two white 3x2 rounded plates (b124 lower, b123 upper, offset). Sub-step 2 adds a white curved 2x1 brick (b125). Sub-step 3 adds the grate slope (b127) and the corner tile (b126). The corner tile is not clearly shown, so its position is a guess.
The lower plate b124 is assumed to sit on the jumper plate b36 at the left front of the model. This is a guess.
Step 41 builds the same small sub-assembly as step 40 (two rounded plates, curved brick, corner tile, grate slope) and sets it on the right front of the model. This is the mirror of the left one.
The lower plate b129 is assumed to sit on the jumper plate b37. The corner tile position is a guess.
Step 42 adds a white 1x6 tile with groove across the top of the visor (the brow), with a white curved 2x1 brick at each end.
I assumed the tile covers the two white 1x3 plates from step 37 and each curved brick sits on a black wedge. These are best guesses.
Step 43 adds a white 2x2 left wedge and a white 2x2 right wedge, a tan 2x4 plate and two black 2x4 tiles with groove. They fill the visor area.
The parts-list tracker shows no black 2x4 tiles left, but the original list has six and only four are placed so far, so two remain.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 44 adds the second white 2x6 plate and a long, thin black tile at the lower front of the visor.

I read the black tile as the black Tile 1 x 3 (lego-63864). That is the only black tile still unaccounted for, since the one black 1x6 tile went into step 25. This also relies on my earlier correction that b9 is a 2x4 tile.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 45 adds two white 4x2 right wedge plates and two white 4x2 left wedge plates, which build up the lower face.
The picture shows 3 studs on each wedge, which fits the 4x2 wedges (the only 4x2 white wedges in the parts list).
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
Step 46 adds two white 4x2 right wedge plates and two white 4x2 left wedge plates, and a light bluish gray round 1x1 tile on the tip stud of one wedge. The tile sits at the centre of the chin.

Correction to step 45: the wedges there had 3 studs along their length, so they were probably white 3x2 wedges (two lego-43722 and two white lego-43723), not 4x2 ones. The 4-stud wedges on this page are the 4x2 ones. Step 45 pieces b143-b146 are therefore likely mistyped. I could not change earlier output.
The supports are best guesses from the picture.
This page has no building step. It shows the finished model from the back with the U-shaped stand (b88-b94) swung out on its hinges (b93, b94 to b85, b86) so the model stands upright.

The parts list still shows a few unplaced pieces (white 3x2 right wedges, red 3x2 left wedges, red 1x3 tile, red 2x4 tile). I think this comes from earlier steps where I had to guess piece types and colours, not from pieces missing in the model. They may still appear on a later page.
This page has no building step. It shows the finished First Order Stormtrooper Brick Sketch standing on its swing-out stand. No pieces are added.
This page is an advertisement for the LEGO product feedback prize draw. It has no building step, so no pieces are added.

Four parts-list lines are still unplaced: white 3x2 right wedges (43722) x2, red 3x2 left wedges (43723) x2, red 1x3 tile x1 and red 2x4 tile x1. The previous page was the finished model and no page shows them being placed. The earlier red pieces (b3-b8, b15-b22, b25-b31) were assigned from the pictures. I could not match every red piece type to the parts list. The unplaced red items are probably some of those with the wrong type, and the unplaced white wedges are probably the ones I recorded as 4x2 wedges in step 45 (b143-b146).
